doc.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Born in Milwaukee, family moves to California
summary: Hardaway was born in Milwaukee and the family left when he was three; he jokes he couldn't find a rhythm section. He is nearly a native Californian.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You know it’s a long way from Milwaukee. That’s where you came from?
I was born in Milwaukee, yes.
We left when I was three years old, I couldn’t find a rhythm section.
Good one, good one. I like that.
And so we came out here and have been up in this general area.
So you’re really almost a native Californian.
